'''Martan''' is a clerk in the [[White Tower]] during the [[Aiel War]].

==Appearance==
Martan is a strapping young man with beautiful brown eyes, according to [[Moiraine Damodred]].

==History==
Martan and Mistress [[Wellin]] were assigned the task of copying names gathered by [[Accepted]] during the White Tower census. When they arrive at their workplace, Moiraine Damodred and [[Siuan Sanche]] are already acomplishing the task. Martan smiles at Moiraine until Mistress Wellin upbraids him for it.{{ref/book|0|6}}

It can be assumed that he was dismissed from his job for "smiling at Accepted" under Sierin Vayu, as she dismissed all male clerks for similar reasons within five days of becoming the Amyrlin seat.
